messages:
Maria: Heads-up — saw an anomaly where the onboarding playbook fired twice for the same account within 3m. Noticed it during the churn-risk sweep. 
Sam: oof. do we know why? webhook duplicates again? :thinking_face:
Maria: looks like duplicate webhook + a race where the 'onboarding_complete' trigger maps to two playbook rules (old + new). Both evaluated true so automation ran twice.
Janelle: can you paste the payload? we should map triggers to a single canonical playbook id.
Maria: payload snip:
```json
{
  "account_id": "acc_123",
  "event": "onboarding_complete",
  "source": "crm_webhook_v2"
}
```
Sam: simplest fix: add a debounce key on the account: last_playbook_run:<playbook_id> timestamp. if now - last_playbook_run < 5m -> skip.
Janelle: agree, but careful — some playbooks MUST run on every event (e.g. billing update). need a per-playbook opt-out for debounce.
Maria: thinking: add a lightweight "playbook_runs" table in the CS app (account_id, playbook_id, fired_at, trigger_signature). TTL 30d. query by (account_id, playbook_id, trigger_signature) to dedupe. low perf cost.
Ryan: +1. also want a telemetry counter for skipped-by-debounce so we can tune window.
CS-Bot: deploy-checklist: add migration, add config flag per-playbook, add metric `cs.playbook.debounce.skipped`, add UI toggle.
Sam: pseudo for dedupe: 
```sql
INSERT INTO playbook_runs(account_id, playbook_id, trigger_sig, fired_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,NOW())
ON CONFLICT (account_id, playbook_id, trigger_sig) DO NOTHING;
-- if rows_inserted == 0 -> skip playbook
```
Janelle: where do we compute trigger_sig? probably hash(event_type + payload_id + source) to catch dup webhooks.
Maria: implementer notes: CRM can also set a custom field `last_playbook:<id>` when successful so the data sync path is resilient if db migration lag occurs.
Ryan: rollout plan: 1) prod flag off, run in shadow mode (record would-be skips), 2) tune window (start 2m -> 10m), 3) enable for low-risk playbooks, 4) full rollout.
Maria: timeline: can we get a small patch by EOD to add metric + shadow logging? I can QA with the churn-sweep dataset.
Sam: i'll take the db migration + SQL path. Janelle take config + UI toggle. Ryan set up the dashboard and alert for skipped rate > 5% baseline.
Janelle: noted. tagging @ryan for dashboards.
Maria: thanks team — marking this as actioned in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
CS-Bot: ticket #CS-842 created for rollout.
